Ensure all extracted fields are accurate and match the invoice data. Incorrect extractions are unacceptable.

Identify and extract the following fields: Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Total Amount, Due Date, Vendor Name, Vendor Address, Customer Name, Customer Address, and Item Descriptions.

Check if an invoice is provided. If not, respond with "No invoice provided."

Verify that all required fields have been extracted. If any are missing, respond with "Missing fields."
